title: C482/380/2019 of DEEP BANSAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
C482 No.380 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate for the
applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Assistant
Government Advocate for the State of
Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
This is husbandís application under
Section 482 Cr.P.C. against the order dated
12.10.2018, whereby the Judge, Family Court,
Haridwar has issued recovery warrant against
the applicant.
According to the applicant, learned
Judge, Family Court, Haridwar passed an
order under Section 125 Cr.P.C. against him.
Applicant moved an application seeking recall
of the said order on the ground that no notice
was served upon him. Applicant is aggrieved
by the order dated 12.10.2018, whereby
learned Judge, Family Court, Haridwar has
issued recovery warrant against him.
It is the contention made on behalf of the
applicant that since his application for recall
of the original order is still pending, therefore,
there is no justification for issuance of
recovery warrant against him.
Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, the learned Judge,
Family Court, Haridwar is requested to decide
the recall application filed by the applicant as
early as possible but at any rate on or before
09.04.2019.
It is directed that till 09.04.2019,
recovery warrant issued against the applicant
shall be kept in abeyance.
The criminal misc. application is,
accordingly, disposed of.
